limitations.scope: Conditional instrumented observations only: not uninstrumented time, WCET, full receiver/IRQ cost or target readiness
limitations.hook: Includes enabled inner probes and their first publication; excludes wrapper prologue/epilogue and final publication
limitations.publication: Publication self-accounting tail excluded/unmeasured; additional overhead remains
limitations.mask: Conservative bracket includes endpoint/sampling/preemption costs, not exclusive IRQ-off cycles
limitations.continuity: Continuous Run-mode/DWT and gross rate bound are an ASSUMPTION; matching Ready/era endpoints cannot establish unseen continuity
limitations.host: Absolute-deadline helper records host send calls only; no wire-arrival/pacing guarantee, calibrated ppm or independent calibration
limitations.statistics: Lifetime min/max only, never subtracted; only counts/sums are per-leg deltas. Packet count is not Clock count
limitations.routes: DIN and USB-host NOT RUN: no physical fixture, not qualified
limitations.persistence: Automatic persistence possible; no content/Start/slot/save/load/delete gestures; no SD byte-immutability claim
limitations.shutdown: Outer managed DeviceSession owns serial, two Stops/drains, postflight and safety latch; scenario verdict is conditional on outer success
limitations.delivery: Exact fences plus available request tail checked; future delivery beyond bounded observation window is unproven

host_pacing.scope: Host send-call intervals only, including failed attempts; NOT wire arrival
